notes.title: Controller Fix & Server Bandwidth
notes.content:
[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] added more bandwidth to server for multiplayer
[*] fixed an issue where controller right axis would be inverted in multiplayer
[*] game will now optimize graphic settings depending on hardware on first start up
[*] resolved an issue that stopped game from being unable to be paused on controller 
[/list]

notes.title: Added Multiplayer / Map Changes 1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Multiplayer:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Introducing the "Only One Way Up" Multiplayer experience. Climb together with up to 8 friends!
[*] Join public lobbies or host private sessions for a more personalized experience.
[*] Dive into the new "Shanty Town Night" map designed exclusively for online play.
[*] Re-imagined "Shanty Town" map for a more thrilling multiplayer experience. Say goodbye to elevators and hello to more jump pads and new areas.
[*] Stay connected with the new Multiplayer Text Chat System.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340474/a310b6a5d83543b7210a736ecae1b1fa2bd75efe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340474/af433fcee4233c5336726d3f274e20958d1c13c4.png[/img]

[h2]Singleplayer:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Discover a new feature: a helicopter on the bar roof! Hop on for a scenic flight, but watch out for engine troubles.
[*] Tweaks to in-game objects and candy for a smoother gameplay experience.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340474/a5c11d23462d94687fafd823ca1ad86650774f4d.png[/img]

Ready to embark on this climbing journey? Grab your friends and dive in! We value your feedback, so let us know your thoughts.

notes.title: Reverted 1.01 - Bug fixes still gone through
notes.content:
We have reverted the map changes / player balance that went through before, we have also done a soft wipe on the leaderboard. We made the map too easy.

We attempted to rebalance the map and also tuned the player mantle detection making it far too easy to complete the game.

We have soft wiped the leaderboard of some of the quick scores from today, we wont do this again. Sorry for the inconvenience. But after much feedback and internal testing we've pulled back many of the changes.


Bug fixes

-Fixed an issue that caused space transition to break
-Fixed an sound issue in space that caused breathing sound to duplicate
-Reverted map changes from earlier today
-Kept jump pad on city building to smooth out gameplay if you fell onto a roof


Sorry again, we will focus on big features now like deeper customization and we are experimenting with a player map creator but dont have further news to share yet.

notes.title: Only One Way Up - Now Available
notes.content:
We are looking forward to your feedback, we are releasing with leaderboards so your runs are recorded. Soon we will add more features such as level editor so you can make endless levels and also customization for the character.


Let us know what you think of the game and if you encounter any issues we'll get them fixed asap. Your feedback is important as we look to update the game in the future again.


Cheers!
